character.label: Character / Figurine
character.prompt_rule: Full-body dark fantasy tabletop figurine on a carved circular stone pedestal base, readable chunky proportions, dramatic top-down dungeon rim lighting, clean isolated background, no cropped limbs.

item.label: Item / Weapon / Prop
item.prompt_rule: Standalone game prop or item with a high-contrast silhouette, centered isometric 3/4 view, clean transparent background, materials matching the project's art style.

card_art.label: Card / Flat Art
card_art.prompt_rule: Illustrated card art with dramatic painterly lighting, dynamic focal subject framed for vertical card portrait, rich atmospheric background matching the project's art style.

ui.label: UI Frame / Orb / Icon
ui.prompt_rule: Game UI element or icon in the project's art style, crisp orthographic front view, clean alpha channel.

environment.label: Board / Environment Tile
environment.prompt_rule: Dark candlelit stone dungeon tactical chessboard environment, cracked obsidian and limestone tiles with glowing orange rune inlays, warm torchlight bounce.

materials.Weathered Iron: hammered dark iron with battle scratches and oiled steel highlights
materials.Mossy Castle Stone: cracked ancient fortress masonry overgrown with damp dungeon moss and glowing magma seams
materials.Crimson Royal: deep burgundy velvet drapery with tarnished silver filigree and dark plate armor
materials.Amber Runes: incandescent carved orange-gold runes pulsing with arcane heat
materials.Aged Parchment & Wood: candlelit medieval war-table oak, tarnished brass coins, and ink-stained parchment

make_3d_figurine.label: Make 3D Figurine (GLB)
make_3d_figurine.description: Convert winning 2D image into a 3D mesh on a tabletop pedestal (Meshy 7.1, 12k tris, PBR textures).

make_3d_prop.label: Make 3D Prop / Weapon (GLB)
make_3d_prop.description: Convert winning 2D image into a game-ready low/mid-poly 3D prop (smart-topology, 6k tris).

split_body_parts.label: Split Character into Rig Parts
split_body_parts.description: Isolate Head, Torso, Arms, Legs, and Weapon into separate clean assets for modular rigging or 3D.

slice_lineup_sheet.label: Slice Concept Lineup into 4 Assets
slice_lineup_sheet.description: Split a horizontal multi-character concept sheet (e.g. Pawn, Knight, Rook, Queen) into 4 standalone assets.

make_variants.label: Make Material / Faction Variants
make_variants.description: Generate sibling variations (Iron, Mossy Stone, Crimson, Gold) with locked silhouette.

approve_2d.label: Approve 2D Asset Directly
approve_2d.description: Finalize this 2D illustration/card/icon and mark it ready for the coding agent.
